claims.evidence: StartWebGoat starts both contexts in one JVM; CommandExecutionService builds /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe /c and starts ProcessBuilder without identity sandbox. Scope is process permissions, not root/container escape.

claims.evidence: DatabaseConfiguration passes the same datasource to migrations and LessonDataSource; wrapper calls originalDataSource.getConnection and LessonConnectionInvocationHandler only SET SCHEMA. UserService creates DBA-authorized schemas. Effective live grants remain unverified.

claims.claim: P08 malformed anonymous mail can persist and break recipient rendering
claims.evidence: MailboxController direct save and POST permitAll; Email.getSummary dereferences contents and getShortSender substring assumes @; nullable migration columns; template invokes both getters. Confirmed source path, not measured runtime availability impact.

claims.claim: P16 credential lookup resets lesson state before password verification
claims.evidence: UserService.loadUserByUsername initializes all Initializable lessons before returning; WebAuthnLessonState removes user state; CommandInjectionTask3Service regenerates flags/files; security config wires UserDetailsService. Framework ordering/caching and failed-login runtime results remain untested, as the report states.

claims.claim: Challenge2 is bounded simulated dispatch, not arbitrary real HTTP/file SSRF
